onedrive.title: Connect OneDrive
onedrive.description: Notion workspace: **{workspace}**. Use a OneDrive connection already configured in Home Assistant, or use your own Microsoft app.

authorize.title: Sign in to Microsoft
authorize.description: Open [{url}]({url}), enter **{code}**, and sign in to the intended OneDrive account. Then submit this form.

onedrive_custom.title: Use a custom Microsoft app
onedrive_custom.description: Notion workspace: **{workspace}**. Enter the client ID of your Microsoft app with public client flows enabled. See the repository setup guide.

onedrive_existing.title: Select an existing OneDrive
onedrive_existing.description: Choose your OneDrive connection. Home Assistant manages sign-in. ZIPs are stored inside its app folder (Home Assistant or Graph), under your base folder and a separate folder for each Notion connection. The first backup starts after confirmation.
